limitations: This acceptance used a private local_trusted Paperclip test workspace, not a customer-owned remote tenant.
It proves real official Agent and Issue API transport, bounded projection, and stable replay, but local_trusted mode bypasses Board key enforcement and cannot prove fail-closed revocation.
The earlier authenticated disposable-sandbox evidence remains the authorization/revocation proof; this current workspace is not production ready.
Usage remains unsupported because the upstream exposes an aggregate snapshot rather than idempotent usage events.
